description.narrative:
The Youth Action Lab (YAL) has youth leadership at its core. A Youth Advisory Board (YAB) leads participatory grant-making to youthacross Africa and Europe, from start to finish! With the PDF, we aim to: 1) Strengthen the YAB during the start-up phase and experiment on participatory grant-making; 2) Invest in capturing lessons and best practices to share with projects that invest in youth leadership (Tipping Point, SP, etc.); 3) Establish and promote an innovative model for youth as part of governing structures of use for other projects. We increasingly see donors pushing for youth leadership with a need to develop our ONL track record.
Young peopleare a key rights-holders group for ER4A and part of our long-term vision. In line with the Manifesto, we aim to be an ally to youthand ensure meaningful youth engagement. We see the need and urgency to continue and scale this work. Meaningful youth engagement has shown to increase impact and nurture sustainability of results. We want to experiment and showcase an innovative YAB as key vehicle for investing in this – using co-creation as a core methodology from the start to develop a partnership and funding mechanisms with young people that truly embodies their leadership and meaningful youth engagement. We see a strong fit in terms of supporting the work of activists and movements, not only will we provide direct support, but we will also ensure youth themselves have the decision-making power over how and who to support!

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib was founded in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Oxfam Novib is member of the Oxfam International confederation. Working together in the confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education for all, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam Novib's main office is based in The Netherlands, it supports the work of a network of local offices, the implementation of global projects, fundraising, campaigning and advocacy. Oxfam Novib’s the Hague office contributes towards this project’s implementation.
